Asset type: one full-height transparent urban background sprite for a vertical tower-stacking game, portrait canvas 1184 x 3552 pixels, exactly 1:3 width:height.
Image 1 is the original 160 x 480 background sprite: it is the COMPOSITION AND GEOMETRY reference. Image 2 is the CURRENT FOREGROUND floor texture, a style-quality reference only. The background must be visually subordinate and quite distinct from that cream/terracotta foreground.
Rebuild Image 1 as clean high-resolution restrained game illustration, preserving its tall overall composition, building placements and the very large differences in building heights. Keep the native composition: broad pale gray lower-left facade with sparse horizontal bands, thin muted dusty mauve column slightly left of center, simple gray-sage central lower facade, darker gray lower-right facade with broad restrained horizontal floor bands, layered slate/gray narrow office towers higher up, a slender observation tower near upper center, and very tall muted blue background towers at top left and top right. A few sparse facade divisions; do NOT add a dense grid of thousands of windows. No gritty texture, no photorealism, no miniature toy palaces, no cream or terracotta walls. Retain large quiet surfaces behind the playable tower. Buildings use a muted gray-sage and desaturated gray-blue palette, cool gray concrete, slightly warmer dusty mauve on the single narrow original column. Use light from upper left consistent with a cheerful daylight game, but flatten background contrast to keep the front cream floor blocks legible.
Continuous facades from roofs to bottom; do not fade their feet into transparency or leave a straight cut across the middle. True transparent background only where the original image has transparency, above and between the highest buildings. No UI, text, watermarks, labels or frame. Output the SINGLE full-height vertical background sprite; preserve the requested 1:3 aspect ratio.
